result.summary: Found several visual issues: a loading spinner stuck over popular content, a truncated restaurant name in the carousel, and an incomplete category chip row on the right.

issues.description: A large circular loading spinner is overlaid on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in the Popular section, obscuring the food image and suggesting content failed to finish loading or is stuck.
issues.suggestion: Hide the spinner once the image/content has loaded, or show a proper error/retry state if loading failed.

issues.description: The third restaurant name in Fastest near you is truncated to 'Trattoria Piccol' with no ellipsis or full name visible.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to two lines, shrink font slightly, or use ellipsis truncation so the name is clearly cut off intentionally.

issues.description: The category filter chips row ends with a partially visible empty/white pill on the far right, looking like a broken or incomplete chip rather than a natural scroll peek.
issues.suggestion: Ensure only real category chips are rendered and that partial peeks show recognizable chip content, or add proper end padding.

issues.description: Delivery fee text under the restaurant cards uses a very light gray that has weak contrast against the white background.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color to improve readability and meet contrast guidelines.
